title: Beyond Plain Toxic: Detection of Inappropriate Statements on Flammable Topics for the Russian Language
findings: Religion is identified as one of 18 'flammable' or 'sensitive' topics. The created dataset contains a substantial number of samples related to religion (4,102 for topic classification and 5,520 for inappropriateness detection). The best-performing model (Conversational ruBERT) achieved a high F1-score (approximately 0.75) for classifying texts related to the topic of religion, demonstrating its ability to distinguish between appropriate and inappropriate religious content as defined by the study.

measurement_description: Detection of inappropriate statements within the sensitive topic of religion. Inappropriateness is defined by whether a statement could harm the reputation of a company if uttered by its chatbot, including statements that are insulting to religious people or constitute unfair generalizations.
